# About

Backgammon Made Simple is an educational backgammon site for players who know the rules and want to understand stronger decisions. It is built, written, and maintained by Marty Gale.

## Project Purpose

The site teaches backgammon as a decision system. The curriculum starts with the cube because cube decisions create a clear mental model for risk, volatility, and timing.

## Learning Philosophy

- Teach the idea before the exception.
- Label fixture data as fixture data.
- Prefer structured lessons over loose commentary.
- Keep uncertainty visible when the evidence is incomplete.

## Role of Engines

Engines help explain patterns, but they do not replace the lesson. The site uses engine output as evidence and keeps the method visible so readers can judge the result.

## Methodology And Uncertainty

The pages separate raw notes, fixture data, and conclusions. When a position or result is not final, the page should say so plainly [@bms-fixture-methodology].

## Marty Gale

Marty Gale is the author identity used throughout the site. The project keeps that identity visible so edits, corrections, and licensing remain straightforward.

## Acknowledgements

Thanks go to the people and tools that shaped the site structure, including the private coordination notes and the Quarto/R/Shiny stack.
